item.title: Trump bought up to US$265,000 of Nvidia stock in September, disclosure shows
item.description: US President Donald Trump bought as much as US$265,000 in Nvidia stock and sold as much as US$15,000 worth of the stock in September, weeks before reports surfaced of CEO Jensen Huang’s ties to an alleged Chinese spy, according to Trump’s latest financial disclosure released on Thursday. US lawmakers have been asking questions about Trump’s knowledge of Huang’s personal life, and the ‌president has said he “was amazed” by the allegations against Huang, who is among the president’s closest allies...

item.title: US acts against Chinese telecoms firms hours after Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: The United States on Thursday banned Chinese telecoms operators from directly accessing US phone numbers on national security grounds, just hours after President Donald Trump held talks with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen. item.title: 4 UK men guilty of sex crimes against drugged woman in case with echoes of Pelicot
item.description: Four British men were convicted on Thursday of raping or sexually abusing a woman who was drugged by her then husband in a case with echoes of that of Gisele Pelicot, the French woman who became a global symbol in the fight against sexual violence. Joanne Young, like Pelicot, decided to waive her legal right to anonymity after discovering that her husband at the time had repeatedly drugged her and ‌advertised her for sex online to strangers over more than a decade. item.title: Nasa’s Voyager 1 phones home from an awe-inspiring 1 light-day away
item.description: Nasa’s Voyager 1 has phoned home from one light-day away, humanity’s first emissary to cross this monumental threshold way out in interstellar space. Flight controllers received the spacecraft’s call on Thursday, exactly 24 hours after it was sent. That is how long it took for the radio signal to traverse the more than 16 billion miles (26 billion kilometres) at the speed of light. “Travelling a light-day is a singular feat for a spacecraft, but Voyager is so much more than a distant traveller,”...

item.title: 3 dead, 3 trapped as Georgia building collapses after gas blast
item.description: A suspected natural gas explosion in a residential block in Tbilisi in the country of Georgia killed three people on Thursday, while three others remained trapped under rubble, officials said. “Rescuers recovered the bodies of two women and a child from the wreckage” of the five-storey building in the suburban Ponichala district, Emergency Management Service chief Teimuraz Mgebrishvili told reporters.
